limits.command_requirements: Official executed theory command positions, not native support or proof
limits.external_executables: Successful exec paths only; not permission, argv or environment
limits.fixed_source_reads: Successful selected syscalls on current verified fixed-source bytes; not bytes at syscall time or complete language execution
limits.generated_inputs: Successful generated mount accesses; no immutable source hash
limits.ml_file_bindings: Official file-command parser binding, not implicit ML runtime loads
limits.theory_graph: Decoded static inventory parents/imports; not a runtime resource graph
limits.unresolved_resources: Relative paths and source directories are not credited as file inputs, regardless of syscall outcome

coverage.ordering: Per-theory source order and per-trace/per-thread syscall evidence; no global logical order

provenance.command_requirements: strict decoded official execution command occurrences; trusted_loader.rs frontend scope
provenance.fixed_source_reads: build/inventory strace -yy open/openat results plus fixed-source current bytes
provenance.generated_inputs: build/inventory strace -yy open/openat results and isolated writable mount configuration
provenance.ml_file_bindings: strict decoded official execution resolved file-command inputs and verified fixed-source bytes
provenance.theory_graph: strict decoded official inventory and fixed-source SHA256 manifest
provenance.unresolved_resources: build/inventory strace unresolved relative open/openat or source directory observation

limits: This is a frozen reference observation, not a production loader manifest, execution permission, approved axiom basis or accepted theorem cache.
Named static fact groups do not cover anonymous intermediate facts or all generated proof steps. Full structured payloads remain in the hash-bound external run artifacts.
The inventory owner is the certificate context after Thm.transfer, not the derivation or declaration origin. It cannot supply Rust accepted_in.
Internal sort constraints are not exported. Named theorem dependencies are not a complete axiom or conservative-extension dependency closure; missing evidence must not be replaced by empty sets.
Source reads include the broader Pure/HOL build; a successful open is not evidence of command execution or necessity in the nine-root production closure.
Registered public ML symbols are not an actual call graph; per-context type displays and positions are in the hash-bound interface artifact.
External executable paths are observations, not permissions; native veriT execution requires a separately approved restricted effect policy.
